proposals.hypothesis: Li3PO4 is a known cathode coating with high Li-ion conductivity and wide band gap, potentially stabilizing the LiCoO2 interface.
LiF is a simple halide with large band gap and may be chemically compatible with the chloride electrolyte, providing insulation.
Lithium-rich silicate Li8SiO6 may offer good insulation and moderate Li-ion conductivity suitable for a protective layer.
Lithium metaborate LiBO2 is a glass-forming insulator that could form a uniform coating with high electrochemical stability.
Complex oxide LiNbZnO4 may exhibit high dielectric constant and wide band gap, beneficial for insulating coatings.
Mixed Al-B borate LiAlB2O5 could combine the stability of alumina and low melting point of borates for effective coating.
Borophosphate Li3B(PO4)2 may offer tailored ionic and insulating properties from both borate and phosphate groups.
Tantalate Li5TaO5 is expected to be a wide-band-gap insulator with good chemical stability against oxide electrodes.
Complex fluoride Li3AlF6 may provide high band gap and compatibility with halide-based electrolytes.
Zinc phosphate LiZnPO4 is an insulating material that can form stable protective layers on cathode surfaces.
